featured_reviews.name: Arjun Pitroda
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I recently visited this location and was very pleased with the overall experience. The first thing I noticed was how clean and well-maintained the entire establishment is. The lobby, common areas, and especially the auditorium itself were all spotless, which immediately makes for a better visit. The seating was comfortable, allowing for a relaxed viewing experience.
​From a technical standpoint, the theatre really delivers. The screen quality was excellent—it was bright, clear, and provided a fantastic picture. Equally impressive was the good sound system. The audio was sharp, immersive, and well-balanced, enhancing the movie without being overly loud or muffled.
​If you are looking for a reliable, decent theatre that provides a high-quality visual and audio experience, this is a solid choice. Highly recommended for a satisfying movie night out!

featured_reviews.name: Sureshkumar Nagarajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited PVR LIDO Juhu for the first time on 21st Sept 2025 to watch "The God Father" Rerelease!

This property is easy to navigate and it is just right on the main road side.

Really impressed with the colourful entrance. Though it is a smaller in size, but the aesthetical looks stunned me.
It given me dazzling bollywood look and feel!!
The Lobbies from main entrance to each theatres are featuring great interiors 👍👍

This property has 3 screens. While screen 1 and 2 are compact theatres, Screen 3 is a bit bigger.

Seatings are at top most comfort with food tray attached to each seat. Each row has big legroom.

Provided Screen size is maximum with respect to Auditorium size is a big plus.

They equipment Atmos system for even these small auditorium. Only drawback in Audio during my show was there was a beep sound making noise in the background.

Projection clarity is too good.

Airconditioning was just right.

Wash rooms are well installed and maintenaned.

Free drinking water facility is good and appreciable.

F&B items prices are high as usual for a PVR cinema.

Major drawback in this entire premises is Low Mobile Network.

Overall it is a nice and different cinema experience in PVR LIDO. Be prepared to watch movie here in a compact sized Theatres. If you come with an expectation of bigger screen experience, PVR LIDO may disappoint you.
Good idea to bring kids to this theater!!!

I have no complaints about this multi screen cinema complex. The seating, the ambiance, the maintenance are all top notch. The only complaint I have is the sound volume in the hall. Despite requesting a staff member at the start of the film, nothing was done about this. I have decided that I shall either not return to this place or, if I have no other choice, I'll wear ear plugs to muffle the decibel level. Patrons may not realise now, but listening to such high volumes over even a short duration, can and will make one lose their hearing faculty.
This is very serious and ALL CINEMA HALLS SHOULD HAVE A DECIBEL MEASURING SYSTEM IN PLACE.
I KNOW WHAT IT IS TO HAVE A HEARING IMPAIRMENT. My son is hearing impaired.

DO NOT RISK YOUR EARS by allowing cinema halls to force you to listen to such high volumes

Unlike most modern theatres where you enter from the front, this one has an entrance from the back, something that instantly gave me a nostalgic, old-school cinema vibe. The screen may be on the smaller side, but both the picture and sound quality were impressive.

The biggest highlight, though, was the ticket price. At just ₹90 for a 4 PM show, it’s hard to beat the value.

featured_reviews.name: Naincy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overview
Cinépolis is one of the most popular multiplex chains in Mumbai, known for its sleek, modern design and high-end cinematic technology. Whether you are visiting the one in Andheri, Thane, or Navi Mumbai, the vibe is consistently premium. It’s a top-tier choice for movie-goers who prioritize comfort, crystal-clear visuals, and a great atmosphere for a day out with friends or family.
Pros:
Superior Comfort: The seating is well-spaced with excellent legroom. If you opt for the VIP or IMAX screens, the leather recliners are incredibly cozy.
Cutting-Edge Tech: They use advanced laser projection and Dolby Atmos sound systems, making the action feel very immersive.
Variety of Formats: Depending on the location, you can choose from 4DX (moving seats/effects), IMAX, or their luxury "Coffee Tree" service.
Cleanliness: The lobbies and washrooms are generally well-maintained and have a "high-class" feel.
Cons:
Expensive Concessions: Like most premium malls, the popcorn and sodas are quite pricey—sometimes costing more than the movie ticket itself!
Peak Hour Crowds: During big blockbuster releases or weekends, the lobby can get very crowded, leading to long queues at the security check and food counters.
Parking Fees: Since most Cinépolis theaters are inside major malls, you’ll have to pay the standard (and sometimes steep) mall parking rates.

featured_reviews.name: Kartikeya Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text:
PVR Cinema – Oberoi Mall, Mumbai

I recently visited PVR Cinema at Oberoi Mall, Mumbai, and had a fantastic overall experience. Of course, the cinema itself lives up to the PVR standard – clean, comfortable seating, great sound and picture quality, and a well-maintained ambiance. But what really caught me by surprise this time was the food.

We decided to try the hotdogs, and honestly, they were far better than the typical movie-snack expectations. The buns were perfectly steamed – soft, warm, and fresh – which made a big difference in texture. The sausage was juicy and flavorful, and they nailed the condiment-to-meat ratio. Nothing was overly messy or underwhelming – just a really well-balanced, satisfying bite that felt thoughtfully put together rather than rushed.

Another nice touch was the small Costa Coffee counter inside the cinema area. It’s not a full café, but they do serve the essentials. We ordered an iced latte, and it was surprisingly good – strong but not bitter, with just the right amount of milk and ice. It was a refreshing complement to the hot food and added to the overall premium feel of the experience.

All in all, PVR Oberoi Mall offers more than just movies – it’s clearly putting effort into creating a quality experience across the board, including the food and beverage options. Whether you’re here for a blockbuster or just want a relaxed evening out, this location delivers on multiple fronts. Definitely looking forward to going back.

featured_reviews.review_text:
PVR Dynamix Juhu is one of the most popular cinemas in the area and definitely offers a good overall movie experience. The location is very convenient, being inside Dynamix Mall above Shoppers Stop, which makes it easy to access and also provides plenty of options for food or shopping before and after a show. The ambience of the cinema is clean, modern and well maintained, giving a premium feel as soon as you step in. The staff are generally polite and helpful, managing crowds well even during busy showtimes. The washrooms and lobby are also kept tidy, which adds to the comfort of the visit.

The technical quality of the cinema is one of its strongest points. The picture quality is sharp, bright and clear, and the sound system really enhances the experience. Whether it is a Hollywood blockbuster or a Bollywood release, the visuals and audio make the screening immersive. The food and beverage options are also decent, with fresh popcorn, nachos and other standard cinema snacks available. Although the prices are on the higher side, the taste and presentation are satisfactory.

The only real drawback is the seating. While everything else matches a premium standard, the seats are not as comfortable as expected. They feel a little cramped, especially during long movies, and the legroom is limited. In some screens, the distance from the seats to the screen can also feel slightly awkward, making the viewing angle less comfortable if you are seated too close.

Overall, PVR Dynamix Juhu is a great place for a movie outing, with excellent sound, visuals, ambience and service. If the seating comfort improves, it would easily become one of the best cinema experiences in Mumbai. I would rate it 4 out of 5.

Movie Max Goregaon - Honest Review

Visited Movie Max Goregaon with friends to watch Pushpa 2, but the experience was disappointing for several reasons:

1. Parking Charges: The two-wheeler parking fee is ₹50, which is very high for a single-screen theater. Even premium theaters like PVR or INOX charge less.

2. Toilet Facilities: The number of toilets was very limited, leading to long queues. The toilets were also very small, which was inconvenient for the crowd.

3. Drinking Water: There was no drinking water facility available, which was surprising and inconvenient for the audience.

4. Sound Quality: The sound system was not loud enough, and I missed many dialogues during the movie. This was a major letdown.

Visited Maxus Cinemas on Gorai Road, Borivali West recently. Overall, the experience was decent, but there are a few areas that need improvement.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I visited PVR Ghatkopar East to watch the movie Raje Shivaji. During the movie, the screen suddenly went off in the middle of the show. Unfortunately, no staff member took the initiative to inform or assist the audience regarding the issue.
After informing the Duty Manager, Mr. Suryavanshi, he stated that there was a technical issue in the backend due to which the movie got stuck. However, instead of apologizing for the inconvenience caused, his behavior was rude and unprofessional. He simply mentioned that the movie would restart in the next 15 minutes.
When we expressed our disappointment and asked why the movie experience was being disturbed, he responded by saying that it was a technical issue and that he could not do anything about it.
As customers, we expect at least basic courtesy, proper communication, and respectful behavior during such situations. Overall, we felt that there was no concern shown towards customers’ time, money, or emotions.
I kindly request you to look into this matter seriously and ensure that polite, responsible, and customer-friendly managers are assigned to handle such situations in the future.
